headline: Google's AI Mode tracks flight prices and books hotels
summary: Google's AI Mode is evolving into a travel agent, now capable of monitoring flight costs and facilitating hotel bookings.
details: Google announced that its AI Mode, a conversational search experience, is gaining new capabilities to assist users with travel planning and booking. The AI can now track flight prices, book hotels, and display costs in points or miles.

Users can describe their desired travel dates and destinations, and AI Mode will present the best flight options from over 300 airlines and travel sites. For those looking to wait for better prices, the tool can track specific flight costs and notify users via email when changes occur. This feature is now available in over 180 countries.

The AI Mode is also expanding its hotel booking functionalities. Users can describe their preferences and upcoming trips to receive a curated list of hotel options, complete with reviews and key details. The booking process can be finalized through Google Pay via integrated partners.

Google has partnered with major hotel chains and travel sites including Booking.com, Expedia, Hilton, Marriott International, and others for these hotel bookings. The hotel or booking platform will handle the reservation and any subsequent customer service.

Additionally, AI Mode can now show the cost of flights and hotels in loyalty points or airline miles. Users can specify their preferred miles or points, and the AI will find matching travel options, a feature now available globally.
